thread:
priya (partnerships): quick heads-up — VectorCloud + Atlas Systems confirmed for our CloudNative Days co-demo on 2026-05-12. Need speaker lineup, demo order, and swag routing by EOD Friday.

mike (marketing): awesome — can we aim for 2× speakers + 1 moderator? marketing can cover booth cards + landing page. what’s the demo length? :calendar:

lena (product): recommend 20m live demo + 10m Q&A. keep 2 short segments: (1) low-latency inferencing on Dedicated, (2) hybrid private deployment with Atlas SI flow.

tom (field-eng): for the live demo we should constrain seq length to 512 and prep a canned prompt set. i can make a small harness. do we have test account creds for VectorCloud GPU host?

evan (hw-partner): @tom we do. evan from Atlas here — i’ll push a temporary GPU image and share S3 creds. expect a 10GB model artifact, plan to host in the same region as the demo VM.

priya (partnerships): perfect. can someone own runbook + rollback? last time we had a cold start 5m delay.

gina (solutions): i’ll own the runbook. plan to add a warmup script + KV cache restore steps. will add a small healthcheck script: ```bash
# warmup
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}'
```

mike (marketing): swag question — Atlas wants co-branded stickers and 200 shirts. do we have vendor lead? also want a promo code for Marketplace listing.

priya (partnerships): @mike i’ll confirm vendor. @lena can we approve co-branding assets? need logo EPS + clear space by Wed.

lena (product): approved, but small ask: use full-color Redwood mark only on shirts, leave demo-only logos on stickers. i’ll upload assets to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.co/partnerships/cloudnative-deepdive

tom (field-eng): for the demo harness i’ll create a reproducible terraform + docker script. tentative snippet: ```hcl
resource "aws_instance" "demo" {
  ami = var.ami
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
}
```

priya (partnerships): timeline check: today - confirm speakers; Wed - logos and landing page copy; Fri EOD - runbook + demo harness; next Tue - dry run with partners. who can do the dry run?

evan (hw-partner): Atlas can do Wed dry run evening PST.

gina (solutions): i can do Wed morning PT and join Wed evening if needed.

mike (marketing): i’ll have landing page copy by Wed 11am. need speaker bios (short) from everyone.

lena (product): speakers: me (product brief), evan (Atlas infra), tom (live demo), priya (moderator). short bios: will DM to mike.

priya (partnerships): great. swag shipping: Atlas will ship items to our SF office by 05-05. @mike please confirm customs paperwork for EU attendees (if we need cross-border).

mike (marketing): noted — will loop finance for customs HS codes.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: landing-page-redwood-cloudnative on 2026-04-28T18:00:00Z — status: pending.

priya (partnerships): final question — will we record the session for gated replay and Marketplace promotion?

evan (hw-partner): yes, we want the replay. Atlas legal asked for a 30-day review window — is that acceptable?

lena (product): 30 days is long; propose 5 business days review. priya can you negotiate?

priya (partnerships): will ask Atlas to reduce to 5 business days. if they insist, we do conditional publish (audio + slides immediately, video post-review).

gina (solutions): adding checklist items to the runbook: pre-demo warmup, credentials rotate, fallback to recorded demo, swag sign-off, contact numbers for VectorCloud and Atlas.

tom (field-eng): putting demo harness in repo: https://git.redwood.co/partnerships/cloudnative-demo (WIP). please don't merge until dry run passes.

priya (partnerships): thanks team — owners: runbook/gina, demo harness/tom, landing page/mike, logos/lena, partner comms/evan. action items due Fri EOD. ping me if any blockers. :rocket:
